content.text: shall a man leave his father and his mother, Gen. 2:24 (Matt. 19:5; Mark 10:7; Eph. 5:31; Moses 3:24; Abr. 5:18). not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake, Gen. 8:21. God is not a man, that he should lie, Num. 23:19. God doth talk with man, Deut. 5:24. man doth not live by bread only, Deut. 8:3 (Matt. 4:4; Luke 4:4). Lord hearkened unto the voice of a man, Josh. 10:14. sought him a man after his own heart, 1 Sam. 13:14. Lord seeth not as man seeth, 1 Sam. 16:7. Nathan said to David, Thou art the man, 2 Sam. 12:7. be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man, 1 Kgs. 2:2. What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him, Job 7:17. What is man, that thou art mindful of him, Ps. 8:4. afraid what man can do, Ps. 56:11 (118:6; Heb. 13:6). a man hath no preeminence above a beast, Eccl. 3:19. seven women shall take hold of one man, Isa. 4:1 (2 Ne. 14:1). make a man more precious than fine gold, Isa. 13:12 (2 Ne. 23:12). made the earth, and created man upon it, Isa. 45:12. trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, Jer. 17:5. yet thou art a man, and not God, Ezek. 28:2. Will a man rob God, Mal. 3:8 (3 Ne. 24:8).

No man can serve two masters, Matt. 6:24 (3 Ne. 13:24). How much then is a man better than a sheep, Matt. 12:12. Tell the vision to no man, Matt. 17:9 (Mark 9:9). God hath joined together, let not man put asunder, Matt. 19:6. sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath, Mark 2:27. No man hath seen God at any time, John 1:18 (1 Jn. 4:12). testify of man: for he knew what was in man, John 2:25. officers answered, Never man spake like this man, John 7:46. who did sin, this man, or his parents, John 9:2. thou, being a man, makest thyself God, John 10:33. Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man, John 19:5. I myself also am a man, Acts 10:26. man stood before me in bright clothing, Acts 10:30. what man knoweth the things of a man, 1 Cor. 2:11. head of the woman is the man, 1 Cor. 11:3. man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man, 1 Cor. 11:8. neither is the man without the woman … in the Lord, 1 Cor. 11:11. became a man, I put away childish things, 1 Cor. 13:11. since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection, 1 Cor. 15:21. first man Adam was made a living soul, 1 Cor. 15:45. none render evil for evil unto any man, 1 Thes. 5:15. man of sin be revealed, 2 Thes. 2:3. one mediator … the man Christ Jesus, 1 Tim. 2:5. Lay hands suddenly on no man, 1 Tim. 5:22.

spake unto him as a man speaketh, 1 Ne. 11:11. looked and beheld a man among the Gentiles, 1 Ne. 13:12. wretched man that I am, 2 Ne. 4:17. cursed is he that putteth his trust in man, 2 Ne. 4:34. Spirit of the Lord will not always strive with man, 2 Ne. 26:11. shall not any man among you have save it be one wife, Jacob 2:27. impossible that man should find out all his ways, Jacob 4:8. by the power of his word man came upon … earth, Jacob 4:9. natural man is an enemy to God, Mosiah 3:19. a space granted unto man in which he might repent, Alma 12:24 (42:4). church be called … in the name of a man then it be the church of a man, 3 Ne. 27:8. as a man telleth another in mine own language, Ether 12:39. Spirit of Christ is given to every man, Moro. 7:16.

you should not have feared man more than God, D&C 3:7. These words are not of men nor of man, D&C 18:34. not fearing what man can do, D&C 30:11. every man esteem his brother as himself, D&C 38:24. that which cometh of the earth, is ordained for the use of man, D&C 49:19. not given that one man should possess that which is above another, D&C 49:20. when a man reasoneth he is understood of man, D&C 50:12. all things … are made for the benefit and the use of man, D&C 59:18. in nothing doth man offend God … save those who confess not his hand, D&C 59:21. without faith no man pleaseth God, D&C 63:11. fear shall come upon every man, D&C 63:33. no man has seen God … except quickened, D&C 67:11. Neither can any natural man abide the presence of God, D&C 67:12. this is what the Lord requires of every man, D&C 70:9. every man … to provide for his own family, D&C 75:28. let no man glory in man, D&C 76:61. father Adam, who was the first man, D&C 84:16. without this no man can see the face of God, D&C 84:22. let every man stand in his own office, D&C 84:109. tobacco … is not good for man, D&C 89:8. God hath ordained for the … use of man, D&C 89:10. man is spirit, D&C 93:33. As well might man stretch forth his puny arm, D&C 121:33. exercise … compulsion upon the souls of the children of men, D&C 121:37. If he be the spirit of a just man made perfect he will come in his glory, D&C 129:6. Savior shall appear … see that he is a man, D&C 130:1. if a man marry him a wife in the world, D&C 132:15.

no man can behold all my works, except, Moses 1:5. I know that man is nothing, Moses 1:10. to bring to pass the immortality and eternal life of man, Moses 1:39. man became a living soul, Moses 3:7. Man of Holiness is his name, Moses 6:57 (7:35). We believe that a man must be called of God, A of F 1:5.
